text: 7h OpenRouter is now part of Stripe. Stripe is building the economic infrastructure for AI. Together with OpenRouter, we’ll help businesses explore new models and optimize token routing and usage. 1,068 19 Comments Like Comment Share Sean McAuliffe 6h The part I keep coming back to is not the acquisition, it is the metering. When the company that moves the money also runs the router that decides which model gets the spend, the interesting question is who sets the price of a token. Does that make Stripe the neutral rails for AI, or the toll booth? Like Reply 4 Reactions Basia (Barbara) Nadolna 6h Serge M. 👀 Like Reply Jing Z. 2h AI compute meeting payments infrastructure—about time! Huge congrats to the Stripe and OpenRouter teams. Like Reply Onur C. 6h Building an agent simulation engine taught me the hard question is never “which model?” It's “what does each decision cost?” Routing and billing in one layer turns token cost from an invoice into a design variable. That changes how AI products get built. Like Reply 2 Reactions Bogdan Santejudean Senior Product Manager | Payments, FX, Card Issuing, Reconciliation | B2B Fintech, EMI Licensing 5h OpenRouter adds the missing piece: choosing and routing the model. That puts selection, metering, billing and payout in one stack. It also keeps Stripe neutral, because businesses can move across hundreds of models without getting locked into one provider. text:
Building a brand is one thing. Building something you believe in is another.

When I started WOODS by Jordyn on @shopify, I knew I wanted to create more than just products. I wanted to build something that reflected my vision, my growth, and everything I’ve learned along the way.

Entrepreneurship has pushed me outside of my comfort zone in ways I never imagined, but watching an idea turn into something real has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my life.

Here’s to betting on yourself, trusting the process, and building something that’s yours. 🧡
